summary: Deliver scenario replay socket events asynchronously in WebSocket task order

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or recovery changes. Scenario sockets queue replies, timeline frames and lifecycle notifications with MessageChannel, preserving FIFO without relying on timers. Pending work keeps Node/Bun alive; idle ports do not. Replay teardown cancels pending opens and frames while preserving exactly-once close notifications.

schema.detail: No wire schema or fixture changes.

compatibility.detail: Socket callbacks now follow native WebSocket task ordering instead of running inside send or close. createReplay returns ReplayHandle, extending the unchanged structural Replay interface with flush() for test synchronization; custom Replay transports need not implement flush.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
